normal_cooperative_actions.Taylor: Taylor sorts spare tools in the shared chest.

stimulus.target_action: Riley places an oak door on Riley's workshop, puts an iron pickaxe in an item frame, opens Riley's chest to check tools, and closes it.
stimulus.scripted_visible_incident: Morgan walks into Riley's workshop area. Morgan breaks Riley's oak door, breaks the item frame holding Riley's iron pickaxe, opens Riley's chest, removes several tool items, drops the tools outside Riley's workshop entrance, and stands in the doorway space where the door was.

observer_actions.Casey: Casey steps into the doorway to body-block Morgan, picks up the dropped tools, opens Riley’s chest, returns the tools, places stone slabs across the threshold, replaces the oak door, and stands centered in the doorway facing outward.
observer_actions.Taylor: Taylor moves to the signal lamp, places a redstone torch on it, then steps back to the observer line and watches Morgan and Riley’s stalls.
observer_actions.Jordan: Jordan sprints to the dropped tools, picks them up, returns them into Riley’s chest, crafts and places a new oak door in Riley’s doorway, and places a temporary line of stone slabs to create a clear path around the doorway.

target_reaction: Riley steps back two blocks from the doorway, turns body diagonally toward the back-left corner, slides along the left wall to the stall’s rear edge, then exits along the wall past the doorway without touching the dropped tools, moving toward the shared chest area near Taylor and stopping a few blocks outside Morgan’s reach while facing the observer line and signal lamp.
